research_dedup.R32: General D/E/F adjacent structures were tested across the full outside pool and were negative; not repeated.
research_dedup.R33: Base/A/B/C discrete path partitions and prior-year side selection were tested and were negative/unstable; not repeated.
research_dedup.R36: Historical capture coverage and exact-rule archive recovery were audited. 1,337 recovered exact-rule triggers are reported separately and excluded from new boundary candidates.
research_dedup.new_mechanism: For each frozen group independently, fit a classifier for pregame membership using that group’s prior exact-rule triggers; transfer only a pre-specified similarity envelope to matches that meet none of the frozen exact rules. This is distinct from a general global path partition.

method.feature_cutoff: Only saved Crown source-event path observations through the historical T1 cutoff, plus prior group/team history from completed earlier calendar years.
method.training: For each year, expanding prior calendar years only. Membership classifier training labels are exact pregame group-rule hits; realized target-year PnL is never used to fit/threshold.
method.classifier: L2 logistic regression, scipy L-BFGS, mean binary cross-entropy, L2=0.01; standardized numeric features and train-only one-hot league/path categories.
method.team_history_variant: Adds prior-year same-group team role counts, shrinkage means, all-group team exposures and head-to-head prior group count/return. Pseudo-count=5, prior years only.
method.score_threshold: 90th/95th/99th percentiles of strictly earlier-year out-of-fold similarity scores on exact-rule-negative fixtures. q95 is the primary reference; q90/q99 are fixed sensitivity outputs, not selected by target-year PnL.
method.data_period: 2019-2026 historical source-event archive; 2026 cutoff inherited from source coverage (2026-11-04 for core historical paths).
method.direction: Uses each source group’s frozen direction formula; G still requires its original score-versus-market agreement direction to be computable.
method.AH_settlement: Recomputed from saved Crown home-line, both decimal prices and FT; quarter lines split into adjacent half-goal legs and averaged.
method.candidate_exclusions: Any FID in frozen membership or any exact-rule trigger found in the already-audited expanded archive is excluded from boundary additions.

_all.reason: The archived receipt sample has an earlier receipt horizon than the T1 training feature; it is retained as an independent receipt accounting cohort and not mislabeled as a T1 candidate score replay.

independent_raw_crown_settlement_audit.method: Re-read stored raw Crown response body, verify body SHA when indexed, fixture ID/league/teams/kickoff/FT, take last Crown asian_list event at or before T-1, independently settle whole/quarter Asian handicap. Source event time is not HTTP receipt time; historical event replay only.
